title: R’ Achai Beribbi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bekhorot 24b: Rabbi Yochanan said, "R’ Achai Beribbi raised a question." Rashi explains: a great and distinguished man in his generation. Hyman suggests that possibly he is R’ Achi, son of R’ Yoshiyah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Beribbi is an honorific here; Hyman quotes Rashi’s explanation as “a great and distinguished man in his generation.” The proposed identification with Rabbi Achi remains tentative.

The sentence begins with Rabbi Yochanan at the end of Bekhorot 24a and continues with Achai Beribbi on 24b. Rashi calls him a great and distinguished man in his generation without expanding his title. R’ is retained for Achai and Hyman’s tentative Achi identification; the two figures are not merged.
